q2_gaps: a definite / specificational predicate nominal ('X is THE N of Y') - the instruction set covers 'X is a/an N' and 'X is ADJ' only, so the identity and uniqueness of 'the enemy' collapse onto the same Inheritance atom an indefinite predicate would give

a relational noun in PREDICATE position carrying its own of-argument - Complements of nouns and adjectives attaches such an argument to the noun's own symbol, but a predicate nominal has no symbol, leaving the possessor to be attached to the subject instead
notes: 'enemy of' is a true relational noun with no underlying verb, so Possession rather than an (Of ...) oblique is the licensed genitive, and possessed-first order still holds under the copular identity (the enemy IS good). Both atoms are contingent kind-level claims, so the 0.9 confidence dial is applied correctly.
